trap.label: opinião alheia e hipótese
trap.wrong: Some peoples say that traditions are important. If we would keep them, young people learn more.
trap.right: Some people say that traditions are important. If we kept them, young people would learn more.
trap.why: Em português “pessoas” é plural regular; o brasileiro cria peoples. E “se mantivéssemos” vira would no if. Em inglês, people já é plural; if + Past, would + base.

mcq.q: If we kept them, young people ___ learn.

fix.wrong: If we would keep it, it would last.
fix.right: If we kept it, it would last.

fix.wrong: According me, the plan is risky.
fix.right: In my opinion, the plan is risky.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no 2º condicional: “If we keep it, it will last.”
rewrite.answer: If we kept it, it would last.
Some people say that traditions are important.
